title: Public v1 acceptance and original-scope mapping
policy: Original 148-row community evidence and its historical statuses remain unchanged. This v1 register adapts 64 original public/mixed rows, defers 84 community rows, and adds six closure/configuration scenarios. PASS means the stated local scope is covered by executed assertions; PARTIAL means material clauses remain unproved. No local test, internal review or historical result grants owner, editorial, independent-security, manual-accessibility or hosted-deployment approval. Final source candidate is bound below; historical community evidence is unchanged.
